relationships.evidence_quote: Systemic depletion of CSF1R + cells reduced MHCII + M1-like pro-inflammatory macrophages in the DRG, while CD163 + MHCII- M2-like macrophage numbers were unchanged.

relationships.subject: AP20187
relationships.evidence_quote: while the pro-inflammatory genes Il1b and Cxcl10 were downregulated

relationships.subject: AP20187
relationships.evidence_quote: Ly6G + neutrophils (Fig. 4E) were also significantly decreased after macrophage depletion at 8-weeks post DMM surgery.

key_findings: Acute systemic macrophage depletion alleviated pain-related behaviors in established surgical OA in both sexes without affecting joint damage.
Depletion reduced MHCII+ M1-like macrophages and neutrophils in DRG and downregulated Il1b and Cxcl10.
